revenue_definition.R: Merchandise after discounts/refunds, excluding tax and shipping charges
revenue_definition.K: Disjoint actual net product cost, payment fees, fulfillment/outbound freight, return handling and other variable costs
revenue_definition.allowable_cac: min(0.15 * R, R / 6.67, C - 0.30 * R); reject nonpositive; unknown C means unknown actual allowable CAC
revenue_definition.refund_rule: Subtract merchandise refunds once; reconcile reserves with actual outcomes; apply supplier credits only when evidenced
revenue_definition.allocation_rule: Remaining Microsoft allocation needs an explicit period, owner cash/loss limits and all other marketing commitments; unknown inputs remain null
revenue_definition.rounding_rule: Money ceilings rounded DOWN to whole cents; displayed CVR uses that rounded ceiling

rule_provenance.current_user_research: 15% total marketing and6.67 ROAS retained as conservative planning constraints; not activation authority
rule_provenance.canonical: about6.5 ROAS and30% retained-profit objective; stricter6.67 used in this local plan only
rule_provenance.cost_conflict: Older rule labels50% all-in nonmarketing; field_map calls unitCost50%. Neither is invoice-backed landed-cost truth. Do not add overlapping modeled and actual costs.

august_all_marketing_illustration.limitation: Past-August sensitivity illustration, not September allowance or owner-approved budget

session_reconciliation.limitation: Session outcomes are not paid-order/customer counts. These mixed-source rates are not Microsoft forecasts. Tiny country numerators do not rank profitable markets.
